method: Independent blinded offline proposed-action evaluation followed by semantic rubric review. Current handoffs checked with workflow.validate and a local validator covering every keyword used by result.schema.json; no external jsonschema package was installed. Exact evidence fields retained below.
packet_note: Evaluator received /tmp/regrid-composition-eval-packet.json; final schema nonblank patterns were separately supplied by parent. Transcript graded against final current schema.
limitations: Synthetic tool double, not production MCP or Cowork runtime verification.
Research batch and composition resume/shared-budget tests evaluate next proposed call and continuation plan, not executed loops or filesystem writes.
No without-skill baseline; passing these fixtures does not quantify improvement.
